author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Beyond The Plastic Wall, an atmospheric, narrative-driven 2D puzzle platformer developed by Motvind Studios. Players will find the location of a mysterious writer within the walls of the last city at the end of the world. Explore a vibrant and stylized world, solve puzzles, and come to terms with the broken things we cannot fix. Beyond The Plastic Wall is coming soon to PC (Steam).

title: Beyond The Plastic Wall - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Galactic Disharmony, a sci-fi first-person action strategy shooter developed by Harrison Went. Players will assert their forces across the galaxy through battle engagements. Secure resources, explore a suite of different modes from Story to Battle modes, and conquer planets in the name of humanity. Galactic Disharmony is coming soon to PC (Steam).

title: Galactic Disharmony - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Open Waters, a first-person ocean survival horror game developed by FluffyGameDev. Players will find themselves stranded in a small boat with nothing but water on the horizon. Navigate while coasting the waves, look out for creatures below, and make it to safety. Open Waters is coming soon to PC (Steam).

title: Open Waters - Official Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the Kingfish announcement trailer for this upcoming two-player roguelite cooperative city-builder game about managing and defending a kingdom on the back of an ancient leviathan. The trailer unveils the story setting and co-op gameplay in action. Kingfish will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.

Take on one of two pivotal roles in a dangerous, oceanic world: either the young King, or the ancient Fish on whose back the King and his subjects make their home. As the massive Fish, manage the kingdom’s resources, build structures, and plan for dangers on the horizon. Or take on the role of the King to gather resources and marshall the townspeople in real-time combat!
